title: Every family has all four elements
caption:
Every family has all four elements, usually at the same dinner.

Air knows everyone's news and tells it with sound effects. Fire runs the kitchen and the seating plan. Water calms every argument with one sentence and a cup of tea. Earth remembers every birthday, recipe and family story.

Send this to the family chat and assign everyone an element. Then compare with Mizaj Milan.
